{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Drones Button.png|frameless|left]]
Drones are unlocked during the tutorial. They automatically gather ores, even while in offline mode. Coins can be used to purchase Drone Points, which are used to purchase various upgrades that enhance Drone performance. Drones do damage based on Pickaxe Damage. They also use Pickaxe crit chances and multipliers.

{{clear|left}}
== Unlocking Drones==
Currently, 5 mining drones can be unlocked and operating at the same time.
# After [[Obelisk]] Level 2, purchased in the Drones menu
# Unlocked in {{Sprite|Misc Store|Store#Gem_Unlocks|16|Store}} for {{Gems|200}}
# After [[Obelisk]] Level 26 via the {{Sprite|Three's A Crowd|Skill-Tree#ThreesACrowd|16|Three's A Crowd}} skill, for 40 {{Sprite|Skill Point|Skills|16|Skill Points}}
# [[Fishing#tabber-Cthulhu|Cthulhu]] rank 2 fishing tribute {{Sprite|Abyss_Legendary_Fish|Fishing#tabber-Cthulhu|16|Tribute D6T2}}
# [[Fishing#tabber-Blackened_Basker|Blackened Basker]] rank 2 fishing tribute {{Sprite|Galaxy Legendary Fish|Fishing#tabber-Blackened_Basker|16|Tribute D11T2}}

== Drone Points==
{{Sprite|Drone Point||16|Drone Points}} are the currency used for buying various [[#Upgrades|Drone upgrades]], unlocking the [[#Drone_Suits|Drone Suits]], as well as [[#Drone_Suit_Upgrades|upgrading Drone Suits]]. They can be purchased with {{Sprite|Gold Coin||16x16|Gold Coins}}, with the cost increasing by 1 gold for every two points you buy.

=== Drone Suit Upgrades ===
Drone suits can be upgraded to improve their abilities.
By default, the maximum upgrade level is 5. This max can be raised by 3 by unlocking Mechanical Evolution within the [[Skill-Tree|Skill Tree]], and by another +7 through [[Drones#Coal Upgrades|Coal Upgrades]] (+2 from standard [[Drones#Coal Upgrades|Coal Upgrades]] & +5 from increased [[Drones#Coal Upgrades|Coal Upgrades]] cap granted by the [[Archaeology#tabber-Epic Idols|Dionysus Idol]]) for a max level of 15.

== Drone Fuel==
Drone Fuel is unlocked at Obelisk Level 18. Drone Fuel can be used to upgrade your generator level, or to fuel a specific drone suit for a duration. While fueled, a drone suit receives an additional buff.

Drone Fuel can be obtained by:
* Purchasing 1 fuel for 50 coal and {{Gems|5}}
* Opening {{Sprite|Gift|Store#Gifts|16|Gifts}}
* Opening {{Sprite|Supply Drop|Founder|16|Founder Supply Drops}}
* Later in the game, by claiming {{Sprite|Lootfrog|Lootfrogs|16|Lootfrogs}}

== Generator==
{{Template:Coal Full}} Coal is produced over time by your Generator. Coal can be used directly for [[Drones#Coal Upgrades|coal upgrades]] or to purchase drone fuel. At generator level 16, along with the {{Sprite|Gasoline Guzzler|Skill-Tree#GasolineGuzzler|16|Gasoline Guzzler}} from the {{Sprite|Skill Point|Skills|16|Skill Tree}}, the maximum coal capacity is high enough to purchase all early game [[Drones#Coal Upgrades|coal upgrades]]. The generator initially produces coal at a rate of 1 coal per 90 seconds. The amount of coal produced is equal to the level of the generator. The  production time can be decreased from 90 seconds to 55 seconds per production cycle through coal upgrades and the Gasoline Guzzler skill. Production time is further affected by game speed and by a [[Drones#Elixir Drone Buffs|buff granted by the Elixir drone]]. 

Coal Capacity for the Generator is calculated as <math>\text{Generator Level}\times 1000 \times \text{Coal Capacity Multiplier} + \text{Talos Idols} \times 50 </math> .

There is technically no max generator level, but the cost quickly scales to unreasonable amounts. The highest amount required for an upgrade is level 34. 

The generator's level is the unlock condition of several things in the game, including the {{Sprite|Nyx Idol|Archaeology#tabber-Legendary_Idols|16|Nyx}} Archaeology idol, which requires level 20, and the {{Sprite|Hephaestus Idol|Archaeology#tabber-Epic_Idols_2|16|Hephaestus Idol}}, which requires level 31.

{{See also|Drones/Costs#Generator_Level_Costs}}

== Elixir Drone Buffs==
When using the {{Sprite|Drone Elixir|Drones#Drone_Suits|16|Elixir drone suit}}, Elixir Drone buffs are activated every 360 seconds (reduced by [[Drones#Drone Suit Upgrades|Upgrade Level]]. Elixir Drone buffs can have a critical multiplier applied to their duration, once the pre-requisite {{Sprite|Desert Legendary Fish|Fishing|16|Fishing}} {{Sprite|Tribute Rank 2|Fishing#Tributes|16|Tribute}} has been completed. The base is 3x duration, but can be further improved via the [[Cards#tabber-Drones|Infernal Elixir Drone Card]]

== Void Drone Mechanics==
Void Drone is a useful drone when you want to gather multiple ores or veins at the same time, or farm a single ore more quickly. This is useful for completing [[contracts]] or the [[Obelisk:FAQ#Q:_What_is_the_"Plat_Strat"?|Plat Strat]].  When fueled, the resource multiplier applies to both ores and veins.

# Ores spawn according to the floor's normal ore ratio.<br>
# Each ore has a chance of becoming a portal, based on your Void Drone's suit level.
# The portal changes the ore, turning it into anything from Tin to the ore it started as. (That is, a portaled Mithril can become Tin, Copper, or stay as Mithril.)
# Your ore (and bar, and vein) income for that ore is multipled by the VP Base Multi, mostly based on your Void Drone's grade.

===Single-Ore Farming===
While the "obvious" use of Void Drone is to let you conveniently farm many ores/veins at once (rather than manually moving between floors), as your Void Portal Chance and Multi go up, Void Drone actually becomes better at farming ''individual'' ores than going without (and the additional ores/veins from previous floors are just a bonus!)

For example, if you want to farm Mithril, the third ore, you would normally sit on floor 5 where it has an 80% chance of spawning, along with a 20% chance of Adamant, the fourth ore. If you use Void Drone, a portaled Mithril has a 1/3 chance of remaining Mithril, but with its ore multiplied by the VP Multi, while a portaled Adamant has a 1/4 chance of becoming a Mithril, again with its ore multiplied by the VP Multi. As long as your VP Multi is at least 4x (which you'll get from Grade 1, before other multipliers), running Void Drone will actually increase your Mithril gain (and give you Tin and Copper, and not hurt your Adamant gain either). Meanwhile, if you're farming Radion-73, the 25th ore, you need a VP multi of at least 25x for it to be positive on floor 41. (Once you unlock Golden Portals, the combined effective multiplier is virtually always enough to make Void Drone useful, so you can avoid doing any math.)

You ''almost always'' want to do single-ore farming on the floor where your target ore shows up 80% of the time, and the 20% ore is the next ore (which can still portal into your target ore). The only exception is if that floor has bad modifiers, in which case you might want to farm at a later floor with better mods.

If you're farming the ''last'' ore in a zone, though, that floor doesn't exist. Instead, whether it's better to farm on that ore's 50% floor (where half the ores are a ''previous'' ore, which can't portal into your target ore) or the first floor of the ''next'' zone (where you ''only'' get your target ore from portals, but all of the ores ''can'' portal into your target) depends on the ore and your portal stats. There are calculators in [[External_Resources#Decision-Making_Calculators]], but you can also simply test both of them for a few minutes offline and see which gives you better ores/hour.

===Veins===
A portaled ore has a chance to become a vein, as normal for that ore type (not the floor you're actually on). That is, a Cranium ore on floor 42 that is portaled into a Tin ore will become a Stone Vein, using the Stone Vein rarity (rather than the Atomic Vein rarity). Vein income is multiplied by the portal in the same way as ores.

Note: Runite is the only ore that exists in two different zones, both Stone and Magma. While a ''natural'' Runite ore will become a Stone or Magma vein depending on which zone you're actually in, a ''portaled in'' Runite ore will always become a Stone vein. (Even if it ''started'' as a natural Runite on floor 9 in the Magma Zone!)

Because there are much fewer veins to choose from than ores, Void Drone is ''virtually always'' effective when vein farming, with its power maximized on the last floor of that zone. For example, if you want Atomic veins, sitting on floor 42 gives you a 50% chance of Radion-73 ore and 50% of Cranium ore. The Radion-73 ore can portal into 25 different ores, 3 of which will still generate an Atomic vein, for a 3/25 (12%) chance of getting a Portal-boosted Atomic vein, while the Cranium ore can become 26 ores, 4 of which will generate an Atomic vein, for a 4/26 (~15%) chance of getting a Portal-boosting Atomic vein. This means that a Portal multiplier of just 8x (a '''grade 5''' Void Drone, before any other multipliers) will cause Void Drone to increase your Atomic vein gain, ''while also'' giving you all preceding veins as well.

===Modifiers===
Some ore modifiers do not apply when an ore appears in a portal. If an ore modifier changes your stats (For example: Golden floor = 50%, Game Speed -30%, Bomb recharge 0.40x), it has no effect when portaled in. If the modifier applies only to the ore, it applies as usual. (For example: Super crit+ only, Health +300%.)

===Golden Void Portal===
{{See also|Stats#tabber-Golden_Void_Portal_Multi}}
If an ore successfully rolls a Void Portal, it then has a chance to upgrade that into a Golden Void Portal based on the [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Void_Portal_Chance|Golden Void Portal Chance]], providing an additional multiplier on top of your base VP Multi. This additional multiplier starts at x5 and can be increased in numerous ways.

===Rainbow Void Portal===
{{See also|Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Void_Portal_Multi}}
If a Void Portal successfully upgrades into a Golden Void Portal, it then has a chance to ''further'' upgrade into a Rainbow Void Portal based on the [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Void_Portal_Chance|Rainbow Void Portal Chance]], providing ''even more'' multiplier on top of the base and golden multi. This additional multiplier also starts at x5 (so x25 compared to a regular Void Portal), which can also be increased even further in numerous ways.

===Galactic Void Portal===
{{See also|Stats#tabber-Galactic_Void_Portal_Multi}}
If a Golden Void Portal successfully upgrades into a Rainbow Void Portal, it then has a chance to ''further'' upgrade into a Galactic Void Portal based on the [[Stats#tabber-Galactic_Void_Portal_Chance|Galactic Void Portal Chance]], providing ''even more'' multiplier on top of the base, golden, and rainbow multi. This additional multiplier also starts at x5 (so x125 compared to a regular Void Portal), which can also be increased even further in numerous ways.

==Trivia==
* Before the drone got upgraded to seek out ores, the drone just swayed from left and right making it harder to destroy an ore.
* There are two upgrades that got nerfed after an update which is the Drone Radius (+20%) and Drone Movespeed (+15%).
